Name: BFAV Void Barn Animals
Author: Ameyana
Description:
Adds void cows, sheep, and goats, as well as void milk and cheese.

No void pigs because they don't really produce animal products, they just find truffles. Also, I just didn't want to bother. If someone else wants to make void pigs, go for it.

Requires:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-68#post-47274]The unofficial update of Paritee's Better Farm Animal Variety[/url]﻿ (You'll probably want the July 3rd 2021 version, not the July 2nd.)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]JSON Assets[/url] and its dependencies
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod[/url]﻿
[/list]
Install by unzipping it into your mods folder like any other BFAV mod.

This is my first mod that I mainly made for personal use, so I'm not gonna be great with troubleshooting. I did test it, and I think I squashed the bugs, but feel free to report any issues that you run into and I'll try my best to figure things out.

If anyone wants to update it, manage it, add to it, what have you, please feel free to.
